reaction: The explanation of how lymph moves is useful.

mostWorthwhile.text: Connecting the collecting vessels was most worthwhile because the description explained how muscle movement and valves help move lymph forward.

leastWorthwhile.text: Adding the return ducts was a straightforward connection, but its result added little explanation beyond the route already suggested by their description.

surprise.text: I found it useful that lymph vessels can contract as well as being squeezed by nearby muscle.

arbitrary.text: None of the actions felt arbitrary; the item descriptions made each connection reasonably clear.

continue.text: I would continue if another chapter developed these connections through a new situation. The explanations were useful, though this chapter’s sequence was mostly predictable.
